title: Design System: MIDI Pedal — Chromatic Deck

display.purpose: Large switch letters and preset names.

status.purpose: Bank, page, state, expression, USB, and diagnostics.

components.name: Inactive Preset Tile
components.description: A fixed switch region with a narrow identity rail and large preset name.
components.css: .ds-preset { width: 228px; height: 105px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: #102229; color: #F2FAFB; border-left: 6px solid #2BE5D2; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; align-items: start; } .ds-preset strong { color: #2BE5D2; font-size: 38px; } .ds-preset span { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-preset small { grid-column: 2; color: #6F8289; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; }

components.name: Active Preset Tile
components.description: A full preset-color state field with explicit ON wording.
components.css: .ds-preset-active { width: 228px; height: 105px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F25F5C; color: #071013; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr; align-items: start; } .ds-preset-active strong { font-size: 38px; } .ds-preset-active span { font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-preset-active small { grid-column: 2; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: The display behaves like a compact stage instrument. Four stable performance surfaces mirror the physical switches while preset color creates a memorable stage map.

rules.name: Full-Field State
rules.body: Position 2 fills the complete tile and adds explicit state text.

rules.name: Distance Test
rules.body: Switch letter, preset name, and active state read before secondary details.

dos: Keep A–D anchored to physical positions.
Use fill and wording together for active state.
donts: Do not make MIDI handling wait on display effects.
